app.name: InShot - AI Video Editor
app.description: A popular video and photo editing app with AI-powered features, filters, effects, and tools for creating social media content.

verdict.one_liner: InShot is a privacy-friendly video editor that keeps your photos and videos on your device, anonymizes data for ads, and doesn't require an account to use.
verdict.summary: InShot is a video and photo editing app with notably strong privacy practices. It requires no account registration, keeps all your media stored locally on your device, and explicitly promises never to collect or store your photos or face data. It does show personalized ads through third-party SDKs, but data is anonymized and users can opt out.
verdict.recommendation_reason: InShot is one of the more privacy-respecting video editors available. Your content stays on your device, no account is needed, and you have clear opt-outs for personalized advertising.

red.title: Third-party ad SDKs collect device data
red.plain_english: InShot uses advertising services like Admob and AppLovin that collect your device's unique identification code to show you personalized ads. You can opt out of personalized ads in the app's settings.

red.title: Some AI features upload photos to cloud servers
red.plain_english: When you use advanced AI features like background removal or precise cutout, your photos are temporarily uploaded to InShot's servers for processing. They say these photos are deleted after processing is complete.

green.title: No account registration required
green.plain_english: You can use InShot without creating an account or providing any personal information. The app does not track your visits or require registration.

green.title: All your photos and videos stay on your device
green.plain_english: InShot explicitly promises that it will never collect or store your photos or face data. All your edited videos, photos, and drafts are saved locally on your device, not on their servers.

green.title: Ad data is anonymized
green.plain_english: InShot says it uses technical means to anonymize the data collected by its advertising partners, so the information cannot be used to identify you personally.

green.title: Easy opt-out for personalized ads
green.plain_english: You can turn off personalized ads at any time through the app's Settings. You can also revoke device permissions like camera and storage access whenever you want.

green.title: Strong children's data protection
green.plain_english: InShot is designed for users over 13. If they accidentally collect information from a child under 13, they promise to delete it as soon as possible.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: InShot uses your microphone when you record audio for videos. Your unfinished videos with audio are stored in the app's draft box on your local device. The app does not access your camera directly.
categories.detail: Microphone permission used for audio recording. Drafts stored locally. No camera access mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use the audio recording feature, we need microphone permission to record audio; At the same time, your unfinished video will be stored in the InShot draft box and local device.
concerns: Audio recordings stored in local drafts

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: InShot does not collect or use your location information.
categories.detail: No location or GPS access mentioned in privacy policy.

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: InShot does not ask for access to your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No contacts or phonebook access mentioned.

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: InShot needs access to your photos and videos so you can select them for editing, and to save your finished work back to your device. They explicitly promise they do not collect, modify, or delete anything from your storage.
categories.detail: Storage permission required for selecting and saving media. Explicit promise not to obtain, modify, or delete local media content.
categories.policy_excerpt: When you use the video/photo editing or collage feature, we need permission to access your local media to select videos or images... We will not obtain any video or photos from your device, nor will we modify or delete the content in your local media storage.

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: InShot shares some information with advertising partners and analytics providers, but they promise to only share what's necessary, require partners to keep it confidential, and anonymize the data so it can't identify you personally.
categories.detail: Shared with advertising partners (Admob, AppLovin) and technical support partners. Data anonymized. Partners must meet same security standards. Immediate termination for violations.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will only share your personal information for legal, legitimate, necessary, specific and clear purposes... we require third parties to deal with shared information with confidentiality and security measures no less than those required by this policy.

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: InShot does not require you to create an account or provide any personal information to use the app. You can edit videos completely anonymously.
categories.detail: No account registration required. No PII collected when downloading app. No tracking of visits.
categories.policy_excerpt: Generally, we do not collect any personal identifiable information ('PII') from you when you download our applications. To be specific, we do not require the consumers to get registered before downloading the application, nor do we keep track of the consumers' visits of our application, and we don't store such PII.

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: InShot shows personalized ads through partners like Admob and AppLovin. These partners may collect information about how you use the app to show ads that match your interests. However, the data is anonymized, and you can turn off personalized ads in the app's settings.
categories.detail: Personalized ads via Admob and AppLovin SDKs. Data anonymized. Pop-up consent for tracking. Opt-out available in Settings. Non-personalized ads shown after opt-out.
categories.policy_excerpt: Admob, AppLovin, as advertisers of InShot, may collect information generated during your use of our products and services, extract your preferences, and use them to show you ads that are more in line with your individual needs. We will use technical means to anonymize the data... InShot will display a pop up to ask you if allow these third parties to track your app use activities.

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: InShot is designed for users 13 and older. If they accidentally collect information from a child under 13, they promise to delete it as soon as possible.
categories.detail: 13+ requirement. Will delete accidental children's data. Parental guidance recommended for minors.
categories.policy_excerpt: InShot mainly provides its products and services to people over 13 years old... If we learn that our products have accidentally collected children's personal information, we will delete the relevant information as soon as possible.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: InShot uses your internet connection to download editing materials like stickers, filters, and effects. It does not collect or track your browsing history or what websites you visit.
categories.detail: Network permission used for downloading materials via WLAN or mobile data. No other information obtained through this permission.
categories.policy_excerpt: Network permission: If you want InShot download the material when your device used the 'WLAN & Mobile Data'. This permission is only used for the function mentioned above. We will not obtain any other information through this permission authorization.

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: InShot's advertising partners collect your device's unique identification code to show you personalized ads and measure app usage. This helps them recognize your device.
categories.detail: Ad SDKs (Admob, AppLovin) collect unique device identification codes. Firebase collects application software list and uploaded content for analytics.
categories.policy_excerpt: Admob Ads SDK... Unique device identification code (Android ID)... AppLovin Ads SDK... Unique device identification code (Android ID)... Firebase SDK... Application software list, uploaded content
concerns: Device ID collected by ad SDKs

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: InShot explicitly promises that it will never collect or store your face data or any biometric information when you use the app.
categories.detail: Explicit statement that no photos or face data are collected or stored. All media stored locally.
categories.policy_excerpt: InShot will never collect and store your photos or face data when you use our application. All videos and photos on your device will be stored locally.

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: InShot offers paid subscriptions for premium features. All payments go through Apple's App Store, so InShot does not directly handle your credit card information.
categories.detail: In-app purchases and subscriptions billed through Apple iTunes Account. No direct payment processing by InShot.
categories.policy_excerpt: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can revoke any permissions you granted to InShot, delete your drafts and content, and opt out of personalized ads. InShot also provides CCPA and GDPR rights for California and EU users.
categories.detail: Revoke permissions anytime. Opt out of personalized ads. CCPA rights (know, delete, opt-out, non-discrimination). GDPR rights (access, copy, delete, restrict, object, withdraw consent, complaint). Contact via email.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may revoke any permissions you have granted to us before, such as permission to access your camera or camera roll; Delete; Opt out. You have the right to 'opt out' of receiving personalized ads.

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: InShot can update its privacy policy from time to time. For major changes, they will show you a pop-up notification in the app. If you keep using the app after changes, that means you agree to them.
categories.detail: Pop-up notifications for major changes. Continued use constitutes agreement. Updated versions have same effect as original policy.
categories.policy_excerpt: When there are major changes to the terms of this policy, for example, changes of the purpose, method, and scope of personal information collection, we will remind you by means of pop-up notifications... your use or continued use of the products and/or services we provide means that you fully understand and agree to the entire content of this privacy policy (including updated versions).
